verdict.rationale: Sprinto is a compliance-automation SaaS platform, so publishing an official MCP server is a plausible capability and the axis applies. The evidence pack never mentions an MCP server or endpoint. The goSprinto/compliance-skills repo provides agent skills installed via 'npx skills add', and the docs offer llms.txt, APIs and webhooks, but none of these is an MCP server for connecting an agent.
